changelog.zh-CN:
CairnLauncher 0.1.0 首个公开发布版本：
- 极致性能：纯 Rust 与软渲染，冷启动约 100ms，内存占用约 15MB
- 单文件免安装，纯便携设计，数据全聚合于 .cairn 目录
- 完整支持微软官方登录、外置登录与离线模式
- 内置轻量版本更新检查与原生就地热替换机制
changelog.en-US:
CairnLauncher 0.1.0 Initial Release:
- Extreme performance: Pure Rust & software rendering, ~100ms cold start, ~15MB RAM
- Single-file portable design, all runtime data encapsulated within .cairn
- Full support for Microsoft OAuth, external auth, and offline profiles
- Built-in lightweight update checking and native in-place hot-swap
